items.title: Mastercard Is “One of the Greatest Businesses in the World,” Says Bill Ackman. Do the Estimates Agree?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman said on CNBC on Tuesday that he picked up Visa (V:NYSE) and Mastercard (MA:NYSE) in the low 20s times earnings, and he called them a royalty on consumer spending. Analysts expect Mastercard’s normalized EPS to grow about 16% a year from 2026 to 2028, faster than the roughly 14% a year they expect from Visa.

items.title: Visa Is a “Royalty on People Spending Money,” Says Ackman. Analysts See Up to 19% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman called Visa “a royalty on people spending money” on CNBC on Tuesday, after the stock gained 14% in a month. Analysts’ earnings estimates for Visa have risen only a little over the past year, so most of the stock’s gain has come from a higher multiple.

items.title: Does Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) Look Fairly Valued After Its 36% Fall?
items.summary: Tencent Holdings has seen its share price fall sharply this year, and that kind of reset puts the focus squarely on whether the current HK$401.60 level is still supported by the cash the business can generate over time. With fresh headlines on both AI infrastructure access and new payment partnerships, the question for investors is how those shifts affect the value implied by Tencent's future cash flows.
